Lena Weber: Okay, let's get going. First thing, the on-call runbook is out of date since the queue migration.
Lena Weber: Priya, can you update the on-call runbook?
Priya Shah: Yes, I'll have it updated by Wednesday.
Marco Rossi: Related, we need to rotate the staging API keys before the security audit.
Tom Becker: Agreed, that has to happen before the audit.
Lena Weber: Yep. Moving on. Tom, please send the cloud invoice breakdown to finance by Friday.
Lena Weber: Marco, could you take the vendor call on Thursday?
Marco Rossi: I can't this week, sorry, I'm out Thursday and Friday.
Lena Weber: No problem, I'll find someone else.
Tom Becker: By the way, I already fixed the flaky checkout test this morning, so CI is green again.
Priya Shah: Nice. It would be nice to have a dark mode for the admin dashboard someday.
Marco Rossi: What if we upgraded the main database to Postgres 17 next quarter?
Tom Becker: Hmm. Anyway, about the memory usage on the worker nodes, it keeps creeping up over the week.
Lena Weber: I'll look into the memory leak on the worker nodes.
Marco Rossi: Back to releases, I think we'll probably keep the weekly release cadence for now.
Lena Weber: Last item, the launch date. Marketing needs another week.
Lena Weber: Final call, we're moving the public launch to May 12.
Tom Becker: Okay, works for me.
Priya Shah: Sounds good.
Lena Weber: Great, thanks everyone.
